'''Hamady N'Diaye''' (born January 12, 1987 in [[Dakar, Senegal]]) is the starting [[Center (basketball)|center]] for the [[Rutgers]] men's basketball team, the [[Scarlet Knights]]. Hamady grew up in Senegal and came to the United States to attend high school at [[Stoneridge Preparatory School]] in [[Simi Valley, CA]]. He did not play basketball until he was in high school, instead playing soccer when he was younger.

In the 2009-2010 season N'Diaye had 145 blocks and averaged 4.5 blocks per game (the third highest in the nation). On March 9, 2010 during a 69-68 loss to [[Cincinnati Bearcats|Cincinnati]] in the Big East Tournament, N'Diaye ended the season with the 358 blocked shots in his career and 145 for the season. Both broke school records held by former NBA player [[Roy Hinson]]. N'Diaye was awarded as the [[Big East]] defensive player of the year.
